text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-98421 fired for service=redwood-api-prod - High 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate (threshold breach). Triggered at 2026-03-14T08:02:03Z

pagerduty: PagerDuty notification: PD-98421 — High error rate on /v1/generate. Escalation policy: oncall-api. Primary page sent to alice.

alice: acking — saw the page, joining. Are we seeing a spike across all regions or just us-east?

dave: looking at metrics, us-east and eu-west show similar increase. Rolling 5m error rate ~18% for text-gen requests.

alice: thx. I can't access the host dashboard from my phone, can someone paste the grafana link?

ben: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/alerts/text-gen-errors?panel=3 — zoomed to last 15m. Also putting the runbook here: /runbooks/api-high-5xx.md

carol: tagging for awareness — possible customer impact. Which customers are hitting the endpoint the most? @erin can you check top API keys?

erin: pulling key logs now. Top traffic comes from key=prod-ingest-42 and test-customer-1. prod-ingest-42 has ~40% of the recent requests and is getting ~22% 5xx.

alice: first action: flip to fallback model variant on the serving pool for critical routes. I'm going to trigger the fallback policy. Will post command I run.

alice: ```bash
# promote model-variant:stable -> model-variant:stable-fallback
redwoodctl rollout create --service redwood-api-prod --route /v1/generate --from=stable --to=stable-fallback --timeout=2m
```

incident-bot: incident-bot: Rollout started: rollout_id=rl-2026-03-14-0805 by alice. Estimated completion ~90s.

pagerduty: PD-98421 status: acknowledged by alice at 2026-03-14T08:05:12Z. Next escalation in 10m if no resolve.

ben: I can't see the rollout logs from my account, pasting output from the control plane: ``Rollout rl-2026-03-14-0805: 30% -> 100% in 63s``

dave: checking serving nodes — some GPUs show elevated kernel time on attention kernels. Might be a compaction/quant path edge-case. Opening a quick debug probe.

alice: after rollout, error rate dipped to ~6% in us-east, eu-west to ~8%. Good sign. Keeping monitoring.

carol: hold, PD policy shows secondary escalation will fire to ben at 08:15 if no resolve. We should keep ppl aware in case of missed ack.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation PD-98421 -> secondary ben (escalation after 10 minutes).

ben: I'm stepping in from standby. I'm going to re-check model variant configs and the autoscaler. If the root cause is hot shards, we should scale read-only replicas.

erin: customer comms: impacted customers are seeing occasional 502/503s during generation. Suggest an initial status post: "We are investigating increased errors for API requests to text generation; degraded performance for some customers; mitigation underway." Want me to post?

carol: yes, post now on status.redwood. Mark as investigational with potential impact. Keep updates every 15m.

erin: posted: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/rd-2026-03-14-1 — noting affected routes and ETA unknown.

alice: quick note: we saw one missed followup acknowledgement window earlier; PD didn't escalate to manager because primary acked, but if primary had missed ack it would have escalated to manager. Reconfirming escalation policy: primary->secondary(10m)->manager(20m).

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation policy check: primary alice acknowledged. No manager escalation needed at this time.

ben: I found a spike in long-tail sequence lengths from prod-ingest-42 — their requests are much longer sequences than typical. It pushes KV-cache memory and causes slowdowns, triggering timeouts.

alice: can we apply a per-key rate-limit or sequence-length cap as a short-term mitigation? Prefer config sidecar tweak so we don't touch customer app.

dave: we can flip a per-key soft cap via gateway: ```json
{ "key": "prod-ingest-42", "max_prompt_tokens": 1024, "enforce": "soft" }
```

ben: applying soft cap now to prod-ingest-42. If they get 429 we can communicate to them.

incident-bot: Change log: ingress policy update applied for key=prod-ingest-42 by ben at 2026-03-14T08:18:40Z.

alice: error rate is back down to ~3% across regions. Rollout + soft cap did it. Monitoring for 30m.

pagerduty: Reminder: PD-98421 will auto-resolve after 30m of no trigger. Current status: acknowledged -> no trigger since 08:18.

carol: great work. We'll keep this thread open for the 30m watch window. Later we'll do a short postmortem focusing on sequence-length handling and per-key policies.

erin: customer outreach: drafted email to top affected customers offering a summary + mitigation steps. Waiting on ops signoff.

ben: one more thing — the oncall handoff at 09:00 falls to me. If anything pops back up before 09:00 call me. Otherwise I'll pick up the watch.

alice: handing off docs: /playbooks/oncall-handoff.md — note the active rollback flag set to false, monitor only.

incident-bot: PD-98421 resolved by system at 2026-03-14T08:44:10Z (no further triggers). Thread will remain for post-incident notes.

carol: assigning postmortem owner: ben. Please include timeline, customer impact, root cause (long sequences from prod-ingest-42), mitigation steps, and follow-ups (quota per-key, autoscaler tuning, kernel perf investigation).

ben: acknowledged, will have a draft in 48 hours. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
